notes.title: CODE VEIN II - Launching January 30, 2026
notes.content: [h3]This new [b]action RPG[/b] takes players on an epic journey where they wield time as a weapon, [b]traverse through past and present[/b] versions of an explorable world and uncover a dramatic battle to save the world.[/h3][p][/p][previewyoutube="rVRzh7Y640M;full"][/previewyoutube][h3][/h3][h3][url="https://en.bandainamcoent.eu/code-vein/code-vein-2"][b]Code Vein II[/b][/url] features action-packed RPG play with engaging combat and a deep progression system for [b]character[/b], [b]weapon [/b]and [b]ability upgrades[/b]. [/h3][h3] [/h3][h3]Players will travel across vast environments with companions who factor large into a dynamic [b]Partner System[/b] as they take on challenging foes and massive, unforgettable bosses. [/h3][h3][/h3][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][b]Gameplay Presentation[/b][/h2][p][/p][previewyoutube="TXvqHwzxJHU;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Video game expert and jacket aficionado Dan Tack is here to shepherd you through Character Creation, Exploration, Boss combat, and more in CODE VEIN II. Won’t you join him?[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][b]Developer Message[/b][/h2][p][/p][previewyoutube="n1N0mJo-jsc;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Let’s sit down the Producer Iizuka-san and Director Yoshimura-san to discuss how CODE VEIN II came to be, as well as some deeper looks at the game’s systems and features.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3][b]Pre-order now to receive the following bonuses:[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Stylized Forma Set[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Forma Face Paint[/b]: A cosmetic item which applies a forma design to the corner of your eyes.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Twin Fangs of the Lone Wolf (Weapon)[/b]: Twin blades engraved with a special forma. Cut through your enemies like a wolf sinking its teeth into its prey with a powerful, lunging slice attack.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45649559/d6e3e3a2c2765e44dff7b20c083c5c5e0531d415.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Discover everything we know so far [url="https://bnent.eu/CV2_LatestInfo"]HERE[/url][url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fbnent.eu%2FCodeVeinII_LoreInfo"] [/url]![/b][/h3][p][/p][h3]Discover more :[/h3][h3][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2362060/CODE_VEIN_II/"][/dynamiclink][/h3]

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.51
notes.content:
Patch Ver.1.51 was released to fix the following bug in CODE VEIN's Lord of Thunder DLC:

[list][*] Players who got “Asclepius's Vestige I” on Patch Ver.1.30, Ver.1.31 or Ver.1.40 are not able to get “Asclepius Vestige Part F” when defeating the Queen's Vanguard Puppet in Depths: Eternal Abyss, which causes the boss area to be unavailable.

“Asclepius Vestige Part F” is now available to defeat the Queen's Vanguard Puppet again once Patch Ver.1.51 is installed.

[*] Fixed a bug in which specific effects of Boss: Lord of Thunder in Depths: Eternal Abyss are not displayed correctly to the guest player in multiplayer mode.[/list]

We apologize for any inconvenience and thank you for your continued support!

notes.title: Update Patch Ver. 1.31
notes.content:
The following issue has been solved for the improvement of CODE VEIN:

After clearing the story and getting all “Maps of the Depths”, choosing “Play the Story Again” will lock again the teleport function, causing players to be unable to teleport when accessing the Mistle after moving to the depths from the NPC Davis.
To deal with this issue, moving to the depths from Davis before unlocking the teleport function has been disabled.

If players are already experiencing this issue, they will be able to teleport to the base from the Mistle in the depths after updating the game.

We appreciate your patience and hope you continue to enjoy CODE VEIN.

notes.title: CODE VEIN - Update Patch Ver. 1.30
notes.content:
[b]System changes[/b]

The following points are changed for the improvement of CODE VEIN.

[list][*] It is possible to move to the mistles in the depths field with “Teleport” in the mistle menu.

[*] The reviving rule of the boss enemy in the depths field is changed.

[*] “Rest at Mistle”, “Using an item to return to Mistle or Gift” can revive the boss enemy.

[*] In multiplayer mode, the time until multiplayer finishes immediately after defeating a boss is extended against some bosses in the normal fields and the boss in the depths field.[/list]

notes.title: CODE VEIN – Update Patch Ver. 1.20
notes.content:
A new update has been released for Code Vein. Update patch Ver. 1.20 implements the following: 
 
[h1]New function[/h1]
- Additional body parameters for character creation mode
- Additional body parameters (height, body type, body balance, face size) are available.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35353624/b71cfd1243ee518e3952294de6d55644c3c8b1c6.jpg[/img]

[h1]Tower of Trials[/h1]
In the Tower of Trials, player have a chance to challenge various demons and bosses they have previously encountered. This is a special Depths location where challenger must survive until they reach the Mistle at the very end.  

How to reach the Tower of Trials in the Depths
1-	After defeating the boss at the Gaol of the Stagnant Blood, pick up the items “Depths  “Tower of Trials” on Louis’s desk in the base. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35353624/6f94039e66c15cdc54df06212f027e80b4643af3.png[/img]

2-	Talk to Davis to access the Depths selection menu. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35353624/c0a77b44e5ad4698dba5e2a419f9ebd53564938f.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35353624/978b6e27bba9771bd81e2ea6d619c73636221ea7.png[/img]

In the Tower of Trials, powerful enemies await you at each level. Defeat them all to advance to the next level. Enemies that appear are different in each Tower and are much stronger than when first encountered in the main story. Additionally, there are no Mistle available throughout the challenge, so make sure you prepare yourself in advance for this survival challenge. 

When defeating all the enemies on each level, you may occasionally receive a “Mark of Respect”. This can also be received when playing multiplayer so please be sure to fight together with other Revenants as well. When attempting to match with other Revenants online, be sure to descend to the Depths location prior to sending or receiving a rescue signal. 

[h1]Additional content[/h1]
- New accessory “YOUNG GANGAN 15th anniversary collaboration face paint” is available.
- ”Happy Holiday” accessory items are available.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35353624/597e114e73ef052030511dd42d50d834f8956a8b.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35353624/12d741c9d50965bb5a3172c6dbc4a2b4359f1b58.jpg[/img]

- “Happy Holiday” colors for night series Blood Veils are available.
- Additional motions are available.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35353624/90cf87c2b8895c2d7a22fe91354284730cfb8a91.jpg[/img]

[h1]Adjustments[/h1]
•	Adjusting parameters of some Blood Codes.
•	Adjusting resistance parameters of partners.
•	Allowing players to cancel regeneration while using.

Thank you for your continued support and Merry Christmas to all the Revenants!

notes.content:

Patch 1.10 has now been released for [b]CODE VEIN[/b]! The update implements the following:

[b]ADDITIONAL CONTENTS[/b]
[list][*] New creation accessories, color pallets and face paints, Halloween-themed.
[*] New function for hair parts that allows to use as left-right symmetry.[/list]

[list][*] Character creation data can be available at the camp.
[*] Extensions can be made symmetrical.
[*] Adjustments to accessory costs.[/list]

[list][*] Add option to lock the direction of radar mini-map.

[list][*] Fixed application errors on the following conditions.
- Moving to event scenes with specific Blood Veil.
- Guarding continuously right after pushing confirm button in front of a closed door.
- Rebooting the game on Steam after moving to sleep mode during launching the game.
[*] Fixed matching facility while using keywords on Steam.
[*] Adjusted battle effects.
[*] Adjusted enemy’s movement.
[*] Fixed other minor issues.[/list]

Happy Halloween, Revenants 🎃

notes.title: CODE VEIN – Patch 1.03
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35353624/feb6b60100e166be365c5f392a6c80ddfc6822ca.jpg[/img]

A new update is now live for CODE VEIN.
This is a bug fix patch to address some critical issues, which include the following:

[b]BUG FIXES[/b]
[list][*] Fixed multiplayer immediately after defeating the last boss in the Cathedral of the Sacred Blood, causing the player character to be unable to re-enter the boss area to progress the story.
* If you’ve already encountered this issue, you can now re-enter the boss area to progress.

[*] Fixed levers that sometimes don't trigger the doors or can’t be interacted with using the right key.
* If you’ve already encountered this issue, you can now interact with the lever again.

[*] Fixed character sliding without input above 60 FPS.[/list]

notes.title: CODE VEIN - Day One Patch
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35353624/fd4322366f1cec181ebc889e5fe2a6acfce59451.jpg[/img]

[b]CODE VEIN[/b], the new vampiric Action RPG, will be released tomorrow! Are you ready to venture out into a world of destruction to fight the Lost and cure your bloodthirst?

On launch day, we're deploying patch 1.02, which includes the following:

[b]PATCH 1.02 CONTENTS[/b]
[list][*] Players will be able to increase difficulty in a New Game+ mode after clearing the game.

[*] In the New Game+ mode, players will be able to bring their gear from the previous run.

[*] Some bugs will be fixed.[/list]

Dear Revenants, we hope that you'll enjoy tackling challenges in CODE VEIN!

tags.feature: Players will be able to increase difficulty in a New Game+ mode after clearing the game.
In the New Game+ mode, players will be able to bring their gear from the previous run.

tags.bug: Some bugs will be fixed.
